purpose: Serve reviewed view snapshots and trusted release assets from a configured display host.
responsibility_boundary: Own only the documented product/interface scope. Reuse applicable managed common components without forcing unrelated dependencies. Separate synthetic source acceptance from actual account, data and deployment acceptance.

packages.description: Hatter product policy adapter for the generic Zixcel delivery host
Exact document adoption and trusted RenderPlan application over Crowsi STATE
Bounded site delivery and per-source readiness over exact Projection contracts

steps.name: Pack product adapters and verify official registry dependencies
steps.run:
: > "$RUNNER_TEMP/user.npmrc"
: > "$RUNNER_TEMP/global.npmrc"
export NPM_CONFIG_USERCONFIG="$RUNNER_TEMP/user.npmrc"
export NPM_CONFIG_GLOBALCONFIG="$RUNNER_TEMP/global.npmrc"
export NPM_CONFIG_REGISTRY=https://registry.npmjs.org
mkdir "$RUNNER_TEMP/consumer"
mkdir "$RUNNER_TEMP/consumer/archives"
npm pack --ignore-scripts --json --pack-destination "$RUNNER_TEMP/consumer/archives"
npm pack ./packages/delivery-contracts --ignore-scripts --json --pack-destination "$RUNNER_TEMP/consumer/archives"
npm pack ./packages/delivery-client --ignore-scripts --json --pack-destination "$RUNNER_TEMP/consumer/archives"
cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/consumer"
printf '%s\n' '{"private":true,"type":"module"}' > package.json
npm install --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund ./archives/*.tgz typescript@5.9.3 @types/node@24.12.0 esbuild@0.28.1 @playwright/test@1.62.1
node node_modules/playwright/cli.js install --with-deps chromium
cp "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/packages/delivery-contracts/test/consumer.mts" .
node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit --strict --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2022 consumer.mts
ln -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/consumer/node_modules" "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/node_modules"
cd "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
node --test test/*.test.mjs
(cd packages/delivery-contracts && node --test test/*.test.mjs)
(cd packages/delivery-client && env -u NO_COLOR node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/*.test.mjs)

steps.name: Publish exact reviewed archives and verify official hashes
Restore original Git objects and verify every observed source ref
steps.run:
python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib,json,subprocess,tempfile
from pathlib import Path
data=json.loads(Path('source-consolidation.json').read_text())
count=0
for component in data['components']:
    archive=component.get('history_archive')
    if archive is None:
        continue
    bundle=Path(archive['path']).resolve()
    assert hashlib.sha256(bundle.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==archive['sha256']
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
        subprocess.run(['git','init','--bare','--quiet',folder],check=True)
        subprocess.run(['git','-C',folder,'fetch','--quiet',str(bundle),'+refs/heads/*:refs/heads/*','+refs/tags/*:refs/tags/*','+refs/pull/*:refs/pull/*'],check=True)
        subprocess.run(['git','-C',folder,'cat-file','-e',component['source_head']+'^{commit}'],check=True)
        for reference in archive['observed_source_refs'] + archive.get('observed_source_pull_refs', []):
            ref=reference['ref']
            if ref.startswith('refs/heads/'):
                ref=ref.replace('refs/heads/','refs/heads/source/',1)
            actual=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',folder,'rev-parse',ref],text=True).strip()
            assert actual==reference['sha'], reference['ref']
    count+=1
assert count>0
print(f'Restored {count} source histories and all recorded refs')
PY

evidence_policy: Declarations and source paths are not proof of an executed acceptance. Exact CI head and result are recorded separately. No live accounts or production acceptance is inferred.
